entries.rationale: v1.1 survivor calibration (2026-11-11): the flat SDE>=7 bar passed 31.6% of the proof run, so survivorship also requires a pink-noise MES rescore in tier A or B. The 5-sigma MAD clip has NO depth floor in this version — a known sensitivity defect (a 1.5% transit on a 0.3%-noise star scores lower than a 1.0% one); bulk_v2 fixes it. See bulk/CALIBRATION_V1_1.md.
Deep-pipeline thresholds as run since the 2026-11-13 BLS fix (SDE 8.5 discovery bar, 6.5 acceptance floor). Snapshot of hunter.py's named constants.
Gauntlet thresholds as vetted through S96-S98 (shape-gate V/U bounds, 15% chi2 floor, 10% MAD-clip floor). Snapshot of the gauntlet's named constants plus the stage-result decision policy.

Gauntlet calibration v2 (2026-11-14, Phase 1.2 A-4): carries the stage-result decision policy (raw-flux/parity bars, minimum-data bars, blend bars) and the waiver allowlist. v1's thresholds carried over unchanged; the policy values were hardcoded constants in gauntlet/stage_result.py before this version. Pre-merge correction (Phase 1.2 follow-up F-1, 2026-11-14): neighbour_search_radius_arcsec added at 180.0 — the vetting manual's 180 arcsecond rule; the code census defaulted to 60 arcseconds and missed a blend host at 66.5 arcseconds (S97, TIC 139524628). gauntlet_v2 never reached main, so this pre-merge edit updates the registry entry in the same commit rather than minting a v3.

Bulk calibration v2 (2026-11-14, Phase 1.2 B-2): fixes the v1 MAD-clip sensitivity defect (floor_10pct clip, same rule as the gauntlet) and hard-codes the per-sector systematic windows from the S96-S98 screens. All v1 thresholds carried over unchanged. See bulk/SENSITIVITY_MAP.md and bulk/CLIP_GRID_CRITERIA.md.

Bulk calibration v3 (2026-11-15, quality-mask fix): extends the screen quality mask to exclude TESS scattered-light flags bits 29/30 (quality_mask 1610629823 = lightkurve default 17087 + bits 29/30). The bulk_v2 rescore gauntlet found 18/25 NEW S96 leads were flagged-cadence artifacts — dips only in bit-29/30 cadences, zero clean cadences in transit. All v2 thresholds carried over unchanged.

External-tool configuration v1 (2026-11-15, Phase 2 2B): shared run settings (seed, timeout, memory cap) + per-tool venv paths and versions for LATTE and TRICERATOPS, + PROVISIONAL TRICERATOPS FPP/NFPP bars. The venv paths point at the Mac (/Volumes/NVME/...); on any host without them the tool stage reads UNMEASURED (missing_venv), never a crash. The FPP bars are PROVISIONAL — the Giacalone et al. 2021 validation bars (FPP < 0.015, NFPP < 0.001) and a 0.5 refute bar — and do not gate promotion until the Phase 2 vote ratifies them (see PHASE_2_PROGRESS.md, 2B/2C judgment call 3). P-10 (2026-11-15, pre-merge correction under the F-1 exception): added the full Giacalone et al. 2021 citation (AJ 161, 24, doi:10.3847/1538-3881/abc6af, arXiv:2002.00691) for the provisional FPP/NFPP bars; no threshold changed.

Deep calibration v2 (2026-11-15, quality-mask fix): extends the deep pipeline quality mask to exclude TESS scattered-light flags bits 29/30 (quality_mask 1610629823 = lightkurve default 17087 + bits 29/30). M-11 verified hunter.py was exposed the same way as the bulk screen (lightkurve default read keeps bits 29/30 on QLP targets). All v1 thresholds carried over unchanged.
